description: Register a dev.antiphony.audio.post record held in a repo Antiphony doesn't host (a person's PDS, a group's repo on its group host), so its audio is processed and played here. Antiphony never writes into that repo.

main.description: Registers a remote post by URI and CID and returns its view. A repo record is read from the repo its URI names, never from the request: its CID is recomputed and must equal `cid`, and its blob is copied after its bytes are checked against the blob ref. A space record is registered on a member's delegation (`delegationToken`), which Antiphony spends to read it from the writer's PDS, or pushed by the tenant (`record`, with its audio uploaded first for that space). Repeating a registration is a no-op, and a new `cid` for the same URI takes the edit; both answer like a first registration. Tenant-level: a service token is enough, no acting actor.

uri.description: The record's URI: at://{did}/dev.antiphony.audio.post/{rkey}, or for a space record at://{authority}/space/{type}/{skey}/{authorDid}/dev.antiphony.audio.post/{rkey}.

cid.description: The record CID the tenant expects. Antiphony recomputes the CID of the record it read (or, when pushed, of `record`) and refuses a mismatch.

processing.description: Opt into processing stages, as on createPost. Stage results arrive by webhook (`stage.settled`, with `uri`).

bytesFrom.description: Where the audio bytes come from. `fetch`: the repo the URI names; the default for a repo record and for a space record with a `delegationToken`. `upload`: an earlier upload by this tenant, so nothing is downloaded; the default for a pushed space record. Any other value is refused.

record.description: For a space record the tenant pushes: the record as the tenant read it, in atproto's JSON form (`$link` for the blob ref). A JSON object, and it must hash to `cid`. Refused for a repo record, and beside a `delegationToken`.

delegationToken.description: For a space record: a delegation token (a compact JWS) from a member's PDS, minted with com.atproto.space.getDelegationToken just before the call. Single use and short-lived. Antiphony exchanges it at the space's authority and reads the record and its blob itself.

clientAttestation.description: A client attestation (a compact JWS) from the tenant's OAuth client, for a space that only admits listed apps. Sent with `delegationToken`.

errors.name: RemoteUriUnsupported
errors.description: The URI is not an audio post record Antiphony can register, or it names a space record to fetch (`bytesFrom: "fetch"`) without a delegation.

errors.name: RemoteRequestInvalid
errors.description: The fields don't fit the URI: `record` or `delegationToken` for a repo record, neither or both for a space record, or `clientAttestation` without a delegation.

errors.name: RemoteDelegationRefused
errors.description: The space's authority refused the delegation: the member may not read the space, or the token was spent or expired.

errors.name: RemoteRecordNotFound
errors.description: The repo says the record does not exist, or the space was deleted.

errors.name: RemoteRepoUnreachable
errors.description: The record's repo, or the space's authority, could not be read right now. Retry later.

errors.name: RemoteCidMismatch
errors.description: The record's current CID is not `cid`: it changed since the tenant read it.

errors.name: RemoteRecordInvalid
errors.description: Not an audio post, a pushed record that does not hash to `cid`, or a blob that does not check out or was not uploaded.

errors.name: RemoteBlobSpaceMismatch
errors.description: A pushed space record's audio is not stored private for its space.
